name: waypoint
description: Waypoint, a read-only lifecycle hub for Azure Boards.

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run package:public && npm run package:dev && scripts/verifyVsix.sh out/waypoint.vsix waypoint 0.0.0 public && scripts/verifyVsix.sh out/waypoint-dev.vsix waypoint-dev 0.0.0 private
scripts.package:dev: tfx extension create --manifest-globs vss-extension.json vss-extension.dev.json --output-path out/waypoint-dev.vsix --no-prompt
scripts.package:public: tfx extension create --manifest-globs vss-extension.json vss-extension.public.json --output-path out/waypoint.vsix --no-prompt
